description: This file defines a mock class 'MediaKeysCapabilitiesIpcMock' for the 'IMediaKeysCapabilities' interface, used for testing media key capabilities in the Rialto client component. It includes mock methods for retrieving supported key systems, checking support for a specific key system, and getting the version of a key system.
